ssh-keygen-ed25519.new:

ssh-keygen -lf ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_deploy.pub
ssh-keyscan -t ed25519 example.com
ssh-copy-id -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_deploy.pub admin@example.com

find "$dest" -maxdepth 2 -type f
